note: Independent authoring from public contracts, old IDs/prompts only, same-actor read-only facts and deployed source. No candidate Agent, paid model, test suite or verifier execution. All monetary amounts are USD; explicit datetime boundaries use Asia/Shanghai converted to UTC. Product counts use templates, not variants. U=12 complete ambiguities + 3 proven read-ACL denials. Source release is measured from the reference deployment, not copied from v8. Page checks are metadata-based and have not been browser-walked.
